newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish-based firm Peregrine signs deal with visa.
newsitem.headline: Irish-based firm Peregrine signs deal with visa.

text.p: Peregrine Systems Limited, an Irish software developer, said on Wednesday it had signed a marketing and distribution deal with Visa International to promote its software products for chargeback processing.
This is the first marketing contract to be signed by Visa International with an Irish-based company.

Under the agreement, which takes immediate effective, Visa will market Peregrine's products -- Merchant Chargeback System (MERCS) and Issuing Chargeback System (ICS) -- as Visa branded software to their 20,600 members world-wide.
